name: MTA Bus Time / SIRI
tagline: NYC real-time bus arrivals and vehicle locations via SIRI and GTFS-RT
description: MTA Bus Time provides real-time New York City bus arrival predictions, vehicle locations, and stop/route data through SIRI (Service Interface for Real Time Information) REST endpoints and GTFS-Realtime feeds. Developers register for an API key and query stop monitoring, vehicle monitoring, and related discovery services for MTA bus routes across the five boroughs.

auth.details: API key required as query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY; free self-serve registration at bustime.mta.info developer portal

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free with API key registration; commercial use may require separate approval (confirm on registration terms)

use_cases: get real-time bus arrival predictions for a stop
track live bus vehicle locations on a route
list routes and stops for an MTA bus line
build a NYC bus countdown display or transit app
monitor service disruptions via SIRI situation exchange
